trial_court: Metropolitan Magistrate, Traffic Court - II, Bengaluru (Crl.Misc.No.21/2021)
case_name: Smt. Ayeshah Parveen Soudagar vs Farooq Soudagar Mohammad

parties.respondent_defendant: Farooq Soudagar Mohammad, husband; Smt. Akbari Taj Sultana, mother-in-law; Naseer Khan, father-in-law; Firdous Mohammed, brother-in-law

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner is the legally wedded wife of respondent seeking relief under Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005.

legal_principles.principle: To prove domestic relationship under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, the petitioner must establish that she and the respondent lived together in a relationship of marriage or in a relationship in the nature of marriage or related by consanguinity or adoption or as family members living together as a joint family.
legal_principles.held: To prove the domestic relationship the petitioner is required to prove that she and the respondent have lived together in a relationship of marriage or in a relationship in the nature of marriage or related by consanguinity or adoption or as family members living together as a joint family.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 — Section 12
keywords: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005

legal_principles.principle: To prove domestic violence under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, the petitioner must establish that the respondent has subjected her to acts of domestic violence as contemplated under section 3 of the Act.
legal_principles.held: To prove the act of domestic violence the petitioner is required to prove any one or more of the acts committed by the respondent as contemplated under section 3 of the Act.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 — Section 3
keywords: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005

outcome.final_order: The petition was filed under Section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 and the court granted the relief sought by the petitioner.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
